cards.name: The Artifact
cards.notes: The importance of some physical object that must be obtained, protected, or destroyed at all costs.

cards.name: The Beast
cards.notes: Great rage or passion; something bestial or malevolent hiding in plain sight or lurking below the surface.

cards.name: The Broken One
cards.notes: Defeat, failure, and despair; the loss of something or someone important.

cards.name: The Darklord
cards.notes: A powerful evil individual; one whose goals have enormous and far-reaching consequences.

cards.name: The Donjon
cards.notes: Isolation and imprisonment; a prisoner of their own beliefs.

cards.name: The Ghost
cards.notes: The looming past; the return of an old enemy or the discovery of a secret buried long ago.

cards.name: The Executioner
cards.notes: The imminent death of one rightly or wrongly convicted of a crime; false accusations and unjust prosecution.

cards.name: The Horseman
cards.notes: Death; disastrous loss of wealth or property, a horrible defeat, or the end of a bloodline.

cards.name: The Innocent
cards.notes: A being of great importance whose life is in danger, helpless, or unaware of the peril.

cards.name: The Marionette
cards.notes: The presence of a spy or a minion of some greater power; a puppet or an underling.

cards.name: The Mists
cards.notes: Something unexpected or mysterious that cannot be avoided; a great quest or journey that will try one's spirit.

cards.name: The Raven
cards.notes: A hidden source of information; a fortunate turn of events; a secret potential for good.

cards.name: The Seer
cards.notes: Inspiration and keen intellect; a future event whose outcome hinges on a clever mind.

cards.name: The Tempter
cards.notes: One who has been compromised or led astray by temptation or foolishness; one who tempts others for evil ends.

cards.name: The Warrior
cards.notes: Strength and force personified; violence; those who use force to accomplish their goals.

cards.name: The Avenger
cards.notes: Justice and revenge for great wrongs; those on a quest to rid the world of great evil.

cards.name: The Paladin
cards.notes: Just and noble warriors; those who live by a code of honor and integrity.

cards.name: The Soldier
cards.notes: War and sacrifice; the stamina to endure great hardship.

cards.name: The Mercenary
cards.notes: Inner strength and fortitude; those who fight for power or wealth.

cards.name: The Myrmidon
cards.notes: Great heroes; a sudden reversal of fate; the triumph of the underdog over a mighty enemy.

cards.name: The Berserker
cards.notes: The brutal and barbaric side of warfare; bloodlust; those with a bestial nature.

cards.name: The Hooded One
cards.notes: Bigotry, intolerance, and xenophobia; a mysterious presence or newcomer.

cards.name: The Dictator
cards.notes: All that is wrong with leadership; those who rule through fear and violence.

cards.name: The Torturer
cards.notes: The coming of suffering or merciless cruelty; one who is irredeemably evil or sadistic.

cards.name: The Wizard
cards.notes: Mystery and riddles; the unknown; those who crave magical power and great knowledge.

cards.name: The Transmuter
cards.notes: A new discovery; the coming of unexpected things; unforeseen consequences and chaos.

cards.name: The Diviner
cards.notes: The pursuit of knowledge tempered by wisdom; truth and honesty; sages and prophecy.

cards.name: The Enchanter
cards.notes: Inner turmoil that comes from confusion, fear of failure, or false information.

cards.name: The Abjurer
cards.notes: Those guided by logic and reasoning; warnings of an overlooked clue or piece of information.

cards.name: The Elementalist
cards.notes: The triumph of nature over civilization; natural disasters and bountiful harvests.

cards.name: The Evoker
cards.notes: Magical or supernatural power that cannot be controlled; magic for destructive ends.

cards.name: The Illusionist
cards.notes: Lies and deceit; grand conspiracies; secret societies; the presence of a dupe or saboteur.

cards.name: The Necromancer
cards.notes: Unnatural events and unhealthy obsessions; those who follow a destructive path.

cards.name: The Conjurer
cards.notes: The coming of an unexpected supernatural threat; those who think of themselves as gods.

cards.name: The Rogue
cards.notes: Anyone for whom money is important; those who believe money is the key to their success.

cards.name: The Swashbuckler
cards.notes: Those who like money yet give it up freely; likable rogues and rapscallions.

cards.name: The Philanthropist
cards.notes: Charity and giving on a grand scale; those who use wealth to fight evil and sickness.

cards.name: The Trader
cards.notes: Commerce; smuggling and black markets; fair and equitable trades.

cards.name: The Merchant
cards.notes: A rare commodity or business opportunity; deceitful or dangerous business transactions.

cards.name: The Guild Member
cards.notes: Like-minded individuals joined together in a common goal; pride in one's work.

cards.name: The Beggar
cards.notes: Sudden change in economic status or fortune.

cards.name: The Thief
cards.notes: Those who steal or burgle; loss of property, beauty, innocence, friendship, or reputation.

cards.name: The Tax Collector
cards.notes: Corruption; honesty in an otherwise corrupt government or organization.

cards.name: The Miser
cards.notes: Hoarded wealth; those who are irreversibly unhappy or think money is meaningless.

cards.name: The Priest
cards.notes: Enlightenment; those who follow a deity, a system of values, or a higher purpose.

cards.name: The Monk
cards.notes: Serenity; inner strength and self-reliance; supreme confidence bereft of arrogance.

cards.name: The Missionary
cards.notes: Those who spread wisdom to others; warnings of the spread of fear and ignorance.

cards.name: The Healer
cards.notes: Healing; a contagious illness, disease, or curse; those who practice the healing arts.

cards.name: The Shepherd
cards.notes: Those who protect others; one who bears a burden far too great to be shouldered alone.

cards.name: The Druid
cards.notes: The ambivalence and cruelty of nature and those who feel drawn to it; inner turmoil.

cards.name: The Anarchist
cards.notes: A fundamental change brought on by one whose beliefs are being put to the test.

cards.name: The Charlatan
cards.notes: Liars; those who profess to believe one thing but actually believe another.

cards.name: The Bishop
cards.notes: Strict adherence to a code or a belief; those who plot, plan, and scheme.

cards.name: The Traitor
cards.notes: Betrayal by someone close and trusted; a weakening or loss of faith.
